experiment.research_claim: Blind analysis and low-intrusion generation of seven basic test-control interfaces in a production consensus library without a human answer key or a predeclared target-specific API shape.

system_boundary.description: Analyze the pinned standalone go.etcd.io/raft/v3 module. Public Node and RawNode protocol APIs, Ready processing, synchronous and asynchronous storage write behavior, Storage interfaces and module-provided implementations, membership changes, and rafttest support are inside the boundary. Real networking, external WAL/disk, application state machines, process supervision, and the full etcd server are outside.
